description: Covers B32, B33, B34. capture.cpp CaptureRun reports failed when the second wait times out and lets the render thread close the file (B32); a recording keeps only the arming (render) thread's calls and counts the others (B33); hook CreateStateBlock (slot 59) and IDirect3DStateBlock9 Apply/Capture, at least as record lines (B34). Opus: thread ownership and new state-block vtable hooks in the D3D9 detours, where a mistake is a race or a crash in the game.
title: Capture: timeout path, render thread only, state blocks
